title: Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Kit Bundle
description: The Lost Mary BM600 Bundle brings the iconic disposable experience into a sustainable, cost-effective format. This irresistible package includes two complete Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kits plus an additional prefilled pod. By providing two rechargeable devices, this bundle ensures you always have a backup ready to go, or allows you to carry two different flavours at once without needing to swap pods. The revamped Lost Mary BM600 kit retains the beloved super-compact 'matchbox-style' form factor and vibrant aesthetic of the original disposable. However, it adds the benefit of a built-in rechargeable battery and replaceable pods. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering the same crisp, satisfying Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) draw as the disposable version, with up to 600 puffs per pod. With inhale activation, there are no buttons or settings to manage—simply insert a pod and vape. The device features a handy status indicator light to track your battery life and supports quick recharging via USB-C (cable sold separately). This bundle is the ideal solution for vapers who want the consistency and flavour of Lost Mary without the waste of single-use plastics. How To Set Up Your Lost Mary BM600 Device Step 1 Remove the silicone plug from the top of the pod. Step 2 Peel off the sticker on the bottom of the pod. Step 3 Insert the pod into the device. Step 4 Inhale on the mouthpiece to activate the vapour. ✅ Ready to vape Lost Mary BM600 Kit Flavours • Blueberry A rich and juicy sweet Blueberry profile. • Blue Razz Ice Sweet Blue Raspberry with a cool icy finish. • Blueberry Sour Raspberry Sweet Blueberry balanced by tangy Raspberry. • Cherry Ice Ripe Cherry notes with a refreshing cooling kick. • Double Apple A crisp blend of Green and Red Apple notes. • Grape Dark, sweet and juicy Grape flavour. • Lemon Lime A zesty duo of sharp Lemon and bright Lime. • Menthol Classic, brisk Menthol for a clean cooling sensation. • Peach Ice Sweet, velvety Peach with a frozen exhale. • Pineapple Ice Tropical Pineapple layered with a breeze of Ice. • Pink Lemonade Fizzy, citrusy Lemonade with red berries. • Strawberry Ice Garden-fresh Strawberry with a cooling Ice layer. • Strawberry Kiwi Sweet Strawberry blended with tangy exotic Kiwi. • Triple Mango A deep, tropical trio of ripe Mango notes. • Triple Melon A lush blend of Honeydew, Cantaloupe and Watermelon. • Watermelon Ice Fresh, light Watermelon with a crisp Ice exhale.
